miniature_scale_rules.description: 40mm tabletop miniature render rules (copy/paste into prompts)
rules: Always specify 40mm scale tabletop miniature for image→3D workflows
40mm scale tabletop miniature, hard plastic/resin model, crisp sculpted details
Mounted on a round gaming base (about 32mm) - optional, can be omitted with --no-base flag
Softbox lighting with rim light, sharp focus, high depth detail
For monochrome reference: black-and-white (monochrome), high-contrast studio lighting, no color cast
Miniature surface language: fine layer lines avoided, clean sculpted planes, readable edges, no smoky fog covering the silhouette
Turntable/consistency: same miniature, consistent proportions across views; front view then 3/4 view then back view
Painted reference: painted like a premium display miniature, subtle edge highlights, matte varnish look
Unpainted reference (best for geometry): unpainted grey resin miniature, uniform matte grey material
miniature_scale_rules.prompt_snippet: 40mm tabletop miniature, crisp sculpted details, studio lighting with rim, sharp focus
